attributes.rule: A change from any other heading, except from [heading 9108](/headings/9108) to [heading 9114](/headings/9114).

A change from [heading 9108](/headings/9108) to [heading 9114](/headings/9114), whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that the value of non-originating materials of [heading 9108](/headings/9108) to [heading 9114](/headings/9114) does not exceed **50%** of the transaction value or ex-works price of the product.
